text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fuujin takes first place! Ines Fuujin 
has won the Arima Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*... *gasp*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: Biggg siiiis!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: Big siiiis, congraaaatuuulaaationsss!!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Is that girl Ines's little sister? 
Yeah, she had another great run today!

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Totally~. Seeing a run like that makes me 
feel like I can power through even my 
super boring part-time job tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you've got some nerve doing that right 
in front of the store manager.

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No! It's not like that, it's on the 
level of making you wanna work hard at 
life~!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, I get where you're coming from. 
Her running really gives people energy, 
doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Totally~. It kinda makes you want to chase 
after your own dreams for real, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOAAAAAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...You carry a heavy burden too, don't 
you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Wah!? Huh, Oguri-san!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I can't just stay like this. I have 
to give everyone a dream once more.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...It seems it was too early to bring 
this to an end. Until we meet again, Ines. 
Right here, without fail."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...? I'll be counting on you then, I 
guess...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...... "To give everyone something to 
dream about," huh?

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: ......Big sis.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Suu-chan.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Keep running lots, okay? Both Sue and 
Lou...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
I love you when you're working so, so 
hard, Big Sister...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Then can your big sister ask for one 
favor?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Su-chan, Lu-chan. Will you keep helping 
your big sister from now on?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Can the two of you help out at home right 
now? So that Big Sis can run in races 
here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Can I count on you two?

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: What is it, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Let's run together with their dreams.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
choice_data_list: Let's keep running and having fun!
